in_sanskrit.name: वसुदेवनन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: Vasu (god of wealth, protection, and prosperity) + Deva (god) + Anand (bliss, joy)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the god of gods (deva) and brings bliss (anand) to Vasu (god of wealth, protection, and prosperity)

in_hindi.name: वसुदेवनन्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: वसुदेवनन्द नाम वसु (वसुदेव) होते हुए देव (ईश्वर) को अनन्द (आनन्द) देने वाला है

in_tamil.name: வசுதேவநாந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: வசுதேவநாந்த இருந்து வசு (வசுதேவ) இருக்கும் தேவ (இஷ்வர்) குலம் அனந்தவின் அனந்தத்தின் ஆவது இருக்கும்

in_telugu.name: వశుదేవనంద
in_telugu.long_meaning: వశుదేవనంద ఇరుపోయిజేమో వశు (వశుదేవ) అయ్యేహేదో దేవ (ఈశ్వరో) అనన్ద (ఆనందేశ్వరో) అయ్యేహేదో అయ్యేహేదో

in_marathi.name: Vasudevanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasudevanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vasudevanand is a name of Lord Vishnu, which means 'God's vessel'. The name signifies the divine being carrying all forms of the universe within Him, providing protection and nurturing the world.
